tasks.label: Patch MathML for Canvas (current HTML file)
tasks.detail: Applies the MathML patches for Canvas to the active HTML file, all features on by default: wraps the content of <math> elements in <mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="true"> when a descendant has displaystyle="true" and removes the redundant attributes, annotates <mtable class="...multiline-equation..."> tags with alignment attributes, and rewrites vector arrows (⃗) as stretchy="false". Run with the HTML file active in the editor (save it first); add arguments such as --features arrow to apply only a subset, or --dry-run to preview changes.

tasks.label: Convert MiTeX to Typst math (current .typ file)
tasks.detail: Replaces #mi(...) / #mitex(...) MiTeX calls in the active .typ file with native Typst math (converted with the tylax crate) and writes the result to <name>.converted.typ next to the input. Save the file first. After running, compile with Typst: tylax can emit broken syntax for some constructs, which needs manual repair.
